note: One entry per use case the watcher follows. 'query' is a Europe PMC search (public, no key). 'laws' are the checks a paper's numbers can be put through; each names the general theorem it is an instance of. A check can only say 'inside the bound' or 'outside the bound' for the numbers extracted. It never certifies a paper.

usecases.title: Humidity-driven bilayers (the biomaterial panel)
usecases.query: (TITLE_ABS:hygromorph* OR TITLE_ABS:"hygroscopic actuator" OR TITLE_ABS:"hygroscopic actuation" OR TITLE_ABS:"humidity-driven actuator" OR TITLE_ABS:"moisture-driven actuator" OR (TITLE_ABS:bilayer AND (TITLE_ABS:humidity OR TITLE_ABS:moisture OR TITLE_ABS:hygroscopic) AND (TITLE_ABS:curvature OR TITLE_ABS:bending) AND TITLE_ABS:actuat*))

usecases.title: Crosslinker dose against stiffness and swelling
usecases.query: ((TITLE_ABS:genipin OR TITLE_ABS:"citric acid" OR TITLE_ABS:"tannic acid") AND TITLE_ABS:crosslink* AND (TITLE_ABS:swelling) AND (TITLE_ABS:modulus OR TITLE_ABS:stiffness))

usecases.title: Swimming: tail-beat frequency, amplitude and speed
usecases.query: ((TITLE_ABS:"Strouhal number" AND (TITLE_ABS:fish OR TITLE_ABS:swimm* OR TITLE_ABS:undulat*)) OR (TITLE_ABS:"tail beat frequency" AND TITLE_ABS:"swimming speed") OR (TITLE_ABS:"tail-beat frequency" AND TITLE_ABS:"swimming speed"))

usecases.title: Xenobots and other cell-built swimmers
usecases.query: (TITLE_ABS:xenobot* OR TITLE_ABS:anthrobot* OR TITLE_ABS:biobot* OR TITLE_ABS:"living robot" OR TITLE_ABS:"living robots" OR TITLE_ABS:"biohybrid swimmer" OR TITLE_ABS:"biohybrid robot")

usecases.title: Zebrafish body plan: somites and segmentation clock
usecases.query: (TITLE_ABS:zebrafish AND (TITLE_ABS:somite* OR TITLE_ABS:"segmentation clock" OR TITLE_ABS:somitogenesis OR TITLE_ABS:"axis elongation"))

bilayer_plate_ceiling.says: A two-layer sheet cannot curl tighter than 2.25 x (swelling difference) / (total thickness).

inputs.deps: difference in free swelling strain between the layers (a fraction, not percent)

bilayer_plate_ceiling.kind: proved bound under stated assumptions (Timoshenko bilayer, Poisson ratio up to 0.5)

bilayer_strip_ceiling.says: A narrow two-layer strip cannot curl tighter than 1.5 x (swelling difference) / (total thickness).
bilayer_strip_ceiling.kind: proved bound under stated assumptions (narrow strip)

strouhal_band.says: Cruising swimmers beat their tails so that frequency x amplitude / speed falls between 0.2 and 0.4.
strouhal_band.kind: empirical band, not a proved law; the Lean file proves only how the band follows from the frequency-speed line

low_reynolds.says: A swimmer this small and slow is in the viscous regime: density x speed x size / viscosity is below 1.
low_reynolds.kind: regime check in water (kinematic viscosity 1e-6 m2/s), integer arithmetic

clock_wavefront.says: Somite length equals wavefront speed x clock period.
clock_wavefront.kind: model identity, tested here within a factor of 1.5; the tolerance is our convention

crosslink_direction.says: More crosslinker: stiffer, and less swelling.

inputs.series: dose-ordered values of modulus or swelling from one figure or table

crosslink_direction.kind: direction only, checked by a script, no Lean instance
